title: Segment Tree with Lazy Propagation: Range Add
statement:
Given an array of N integers, process Q operations:
- "A l r v" — add v to every element in A[l..r] (1-indexed)
- "Q l r" — print the sum of A[l..r]

Use a Segment Tree with Lazy Propagation for O(log N) per operation.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and Q.
The second line contains N integers.
The next Q lines each contain "A l r v" or "Q l r".
